build_generate_level0_puzzles: build a function to generate pushworld puzzles with configurable size, walls, obstacles, and goal objects
create_generate_puzzle: create a single pushworld puzzle string with specified dimensions, walls, obstacles, and goal objects
test_place_object: test placing an object with a given shape and symbol onto a puzzle grid at a random clear location
run_filter_puzzles_by_solvability: run a solver to filter out unsolvable puzzles and rename or remove them based on solvability results
review_failed_to_generate_error: review the FailedToGenerateError exception raised when puzzle generation cannot complete within 100 placement attempts
